t.eng-ummmuhammad: Nun. By the pen and what they inscribe
You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman
And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted
And indeed, you are of a great moral character
So you will see and they will see
Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُهۡتَدِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided
Then do not obey the deniers
They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you]
And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
[And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip
A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful
Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender
Because he is a possessor of wealth and children

ayahs.arabic: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
ayahs.translit: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples
We will brand him upon the snout

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا بَلَوۡنَٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَآ أَصۡحَٰبَ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ إِذۡ أَقۡسَمُواْ لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِينَ
ayahs.translit: Inna balawnahum kama balawna ashaba aljannati ith aqsamoo layasrimunnaha musbiheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
Without making exception

ayahs.arabic: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفࣱ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fatafa AAalayha taifun min rabbika wahum naimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep
And it became as though reaped
And they called one another at morning

ayahs.arabic: أَنِ ٱغۡدُواْ عَلَىٰ حَرۡثِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰرِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Ani ighdoo AAala harthikum in kuntum sarimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit
So they set out, while lowering their voices

ayahs.arabic: أَن لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّسۡكِينࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: An la yadkhulannaha alyawma AAalaykum miskeenun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person
And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able
But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost
Rather, we have been deprived

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ أَوۡسَطُهُمۡ أَلَمۡ أَقُل لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
ayahs.translit: Qala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawla tusabbihoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allah]

ayahs.arabic: قَالُواْ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَٰلِمِينَ
ayahs.translit: Qaloo subhana rabbina inna kunna thalimeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers
Then they approached one another, blaming each other

ayahs.translit: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna tagheena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors

ayahs.arabic: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرࣰ ا مِّنۡهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
ayahs.translit: AAasa rabbuna an yubdilana khayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous

ayahs.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡعَذَابُۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Kathalika alAAathabu walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
ayahs.translit: Inna lilmuttaqeena AAinda rabbihim jannati alnnaAAeemi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure
Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals
What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge
Or do you have a scripture in which you learn
That indeed for you is whatever you choose

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ لَكُمۡ أَيۡمَٰنٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ إِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am lakum aymanun AAalayna balighatun ila yawmi alqiyamati inna lakum lama tahkumoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge
Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُ فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.translit: Am lahum shurakao falyatoo bishurakaihim in kanoo sadiqeena

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَن سَاقࣲ وَيُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ
ayahs.translit: Yawma yukshafu AAan saqin wayudAAawna ila alssujoodi fala yastateeAAoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but the disbelievers will not be able

ayahs.arabic: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةࣱۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ
ayahs.translit: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun waqad kanoo yudAAawna ila alssujoodi wahum salimoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound

ayahs.arabic: فَذَرۡنِي وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَٰذَا ٱلۡحَدِيثِۖ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُم مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
ayahs.translit: Fatharnee waman yukaththibu bihatha alhadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythu la yaAAlamoona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies the Qur'an. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know
And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm

ayahs.arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرࣰ ا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمࣲ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
ayahs.translit: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down
Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala takun kasahibi alhooti ith nada wahuwa makthoomun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed

ayahs.arabic: لَّوۡلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعۡمَةࣱ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُومࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Lawla an tadarakahu niAAmatun min rabbihi lanubitha bialAAarai wahuwa mathmoomun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: If not that a favor from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured
And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous

ayahs.arabic: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wain yakadu allatheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka biabsarihim lamma samiAAoo alththikra wayaqooloona innahu lamajnoonun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad
But it is not except a reminder to the worlds
